angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,645,961 km at 174.33 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.7362 +/- 0.0582 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 174.33 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 3.803 (3.715 to 3.892) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 2,645,961 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.088 (3.044 to 3.132) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 10302 +/- 50.3 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 679023579196041856: teff_gspphot 10302.052 K (16th-84th percentiles 10250.354-10351.043), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 679023579196041856: teff_gspphot 10302.052 K (16th-84th percentiles 10250.354-10351.043), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/piautos.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.767, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * lam Cnc: spectral type B9.5V
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * lam Cnc: main object type *, Star
luminositySource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 679023579196041856, flags_flame 00: lum_flame 146.8044 solar luminosities (16th to 84th percentiles 143.31311 to 150.27826); its log10 is recorded
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 679023579196041856, flags_flame 00: age_flame 0.29199606 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.25777188 to 0.32615685)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * lam Cnc: projected rotation speed 160 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)
rotationPeriodMeasuredSource: Measured in this project from the TESS mission's own 2-minute light curves of sectors 44, 45, 46 and 72 (packages/telescope-cli/src/archives/tess/reduce.mts), by the method and criteria of Holcomb et al. (2022, ApJ 936, 138): 4.58 d, the light swinging by 0.04% as the star turns

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
